entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Android default HttpClientHandler and Chain validation failed #32609

  • Android app refuses to upgrade when switching build platforms #32605

  • Using the latest packages of MAUI for .NET 10 leads to dependencies problems for AndroidX packages #32593
  • i got an issue in .net 10 maui in (domain=IXUserPresentableErrorDomain, code=4) #32588
  • ContentView inside CollectionView reports invalid bounds (-1) during gesture events #32587
  • Layout issue using TranslateToAsync causes infinite property changed cycle on iOS #32586
    .NET 10.0 SR1.1
